ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20740, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <44> Omitted.

<45> The Scholarship Regulations shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3 (1) 1 and (3), Article 8, Article 9, and the main sentence of Article 15 (2), respectively, "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology."

In Articles 6 and 19, respectively, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology."

<46> through <102> Omitted.
